text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yaaawn… Hm? You did great today… too…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh man… Something big happened last night before I went to bed.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: You're not gonna believe this, but a huntsman spider jumped out from under my hat, like "ta-da!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Uuugh… I wonder how it got in there. I've been thinking it'd be nice to get friendly with a real-life spider, but that was a bit much…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems Matikanetannhauser wasn't able to get much rest on account of her new eight-legged friend.
